summary: Iteration 26 — 3 new features tested (coach<->client reschedule with proposed_by + client accept, session-history running total & full-date entries, Profile PERSONAL RECORDS + recent PR feed). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases PASS (test_iter26_features.py) — reschedule sets proposed_by correctly for coach vs client, 403 for non-owner non-admin, 400 on bad date/time; client accept flips coach-proposed pending -> approved and sets inperson_next_session (verified via /auth/me), 403 for non-owner, 404 for missing; /inperson/thread returns attendance_total for both roles and matches real count (increments after new attendance); /inperson/bookings rows all carry proposed_by; /profile/prs returns {squat,bench,deadlift,ohp,total} + recent[] feed with lift/name/weight/previous/date and a heavier logged Bench Press appears in recent[]; booking request/decline/cancel regression intact. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): ADMIN side fully verified — in the in-person room the CONFIRMED booking row shows 'tap to propose new time'; tapping ip-booking-{id} opens the BookingModal with title 'RESCHEDULE SESSION' and submit 'PROPOSE NEW TIME'; API-level reschedule returns proposed_by=coach. Profile PERSONAL RECORDS + BIG 4 TOTAL + RECENT PRs + 'Bench Press' entry all render on the client profile. CLIENT /inperson room UI could not be captured in the test window because the room shows the spinner past our 4s wait (same slow-first-load issue documented in iteration_24) — ip-accept-{id}, 'Coach proposed a new time', and ip-history-toggle were NOT observed live in this run; profile-accept-{id} also did not render because the client bookings fetch hadn't populated when the profile-accept selector was queried (initial 401s during token hydration were visible in console). Code review of inperson.tsx (lines 458-472, 615-630) and profile.tsx (lines 440-467) confirms all three flows are correctly wired.

integration_issues.flow: Client /inperson room initial load + Profile bookings hydration
integration_issues.issue: As bot2 (client), /inperson stayed on the loading spinner beyond 4s and the client-side pending row (with ip-accept-{id} + 'Coach proposed a new time') was not painted during the test window. Similarly on the profile tab, initial requests returned 401 while the token was being hydrated, so bookings=[] on first fetch and profile-accept-{id} was not rendered until a manual refresh. Backend + code are correct — this is a first-paint / token-race timing issue on the client that also appeared in iteration_24. Suggest: (a) retry apiFetch on 401 after the SecureStore/localStorage read completes, and (b) refetch bookings on focus.

action_items: Fix the client-side race where /inperson and profile's bookings fetch fire before hutch_token is hydrated (initial 401s in console). A simple retry-on-401 after auth-store rehydrate, or awaiting the useAuth token to be non-null before the first apiFetch, would unblock ip-accept-{id}, ip-history-toggle and profile-accept-{id} appearing on first paint. Backend already returns the correct proposed_by=coach payload.

Optional: on Profile screen add a pull-to-refresh on the bookings list, or refresh bookings when the tab regains focus so an in-flight coach-proposed booking shows up immediately without a full reload.
Push registration 500 (EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder) remains expected in preview — not a bug.
